Local 2026-07-03 source-control/support refresh. The newest inspected local additions are R685/R686/R687/R688. R685 and R686 are no-patch source-support/audit layers rather than reader releases: R685 routes clean article-level GDZ PDFs for P40/P41 and records P42/P30 source-quality cautions, while R686 directly audits P41 against the clean GDZ article source and promotes no TeX patch. R687 is a narrow TeX-changing P40 source-control repair: on printed p537 / cumulative line 19668 the displayed direct-sum formula begins with source Z_Omega, not plain Z. R688 is a narrow TeX-changing P24 source-control repair: on printed p234 / source PDF p239 the module-norm display changes from `N(\frakG_{i-1}\mid\frakM_{i-1})` to source `N(\frakG_{i-1},\frakM_{i-1})`, while the neighboring ideal-norm bar remains unchanged. The R688 repaired German cumulative compiles to 466 pages. Because the Noether record is at the 100-file ceiling, R685/R686/R687/R688 should be folded into a curated rollup rather than uploaded loose. This remains source-control/support material only, not a reader release, Noether closure, whole-corpus certification, 650+ source certification, multilingual synchronization, or a critical edition.
